name: LoopInterchange
description: Permute the order of loops in a structured operation to improve memory access patterns and enable downstream optimizations.

parameters.name: loop_indices
parameters.description: A list of integers specifying the new loop order (0-indexed permutation). For example, [1, 0, 2] swaps the first two loops.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: Optional tile sizes for each loop. If empty, defaults to all 1s (minimal tiling to expose loops without changing iteration count).
